title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil
description: Intergalactic warrior Star Butterfly arrives on Earth to live with the Diaz family. She continues to battle villains throughout the universe and high school, mainly to protect her extremely powerful wand, an object that still confuses her.

episodes.title: S3-E1Battle for Mewni: Return to Mewni
S3-E2Battle for Mewni: Moon the Undaunted
S3-E3Battle for Mewni: Book Be Gone
S3-E4Battle for Mewni: Marco and the King

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x1
episodes_data.description: As tradition dictates, Star receives the royal magic wand for her 14th birthday, but her parents worry that she is not ready for the responsibility and send her to a place they deem safe - Earth.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x2
episodes_data.description: Star's best friend from her home dimension pays a visit and feels threatened by Star's new friendship with Marco.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x3
episodes_data.description: Star fails her first test, so she tries to play match maker for their classroom teacher to get a better grade. However, she winds up turning her into a troll.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x4
episodes_data.description: While Marco is distracted by protecting his friend, the new school mascot, from being kidnapped by their football rivals, a confused Star believes this to be an upcoming battlefield and starts making plans of her own.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x5
episodes_data.description: Marco breaks his arm before a Karate tournament. Star uses her wand to fix it, but accidentally gives him an evil sentient tentacle arm.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x6
episodes_data.description: Star vies for attention with a foreign exchange student who is visiting the Diaz family.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x7
episodes_data.description: Star is feeling down when her crush Oskar has no calls from her, so Marco tries to cheer her up only that he accidentally summons Ludo and his army of monsters.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x8
episodes_data.description: Star and Marco must go to "Quest Buy", a maze-like store to find a charger for Star's wand.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x9
episodes_data.description: Star takes the Diaz family out vacation to her home dimension of Mewni.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x10
episodes_data.description: Star doesn't get invited to Brittany's birthday party and is desperate to get into it.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x11
episodes_data.description: Star goes through mewberty, which covers her body in purple hearts and sets her off onto all the boys in school.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x12
episodes_data.description: Marco and his friends work off their debt in the Shard Mines.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 1x13
episodes_data.description: Ludo fires the lobster monster from his group and the creature doesn't know what to do, so Star and Marco try to help him out.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x1
episodes_data.description: Star must learn how to free Marco from a magically locked closet without using her new wand.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x2
episodes_data.description: When Ludo is thrown into nature, he must overcome the elements and creatures of the wilderness to survive.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x3
episodes_data.description: Star rebels after the school guidance counselor, Mr. Candle, insists that her future is set in stone.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x4
episodes_data.description: Marco finally decides to focus on earning his red belt in karate.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x5
episodes_data.description: When Marco teaches Star how to ride a bike but forgets to tell her about brakes, he teams up with Oskar and Glossaryck to save her.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x6
episodes_data.description: A mysterious stray dog steals Star’s wand and refuses give it back.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x7
episodes_data.description: Star goes on the run after accidentally crushing a police car.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x8
episodes_data.description: Star and Ludo struggle to get their new wands under control.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x9
episodes_data.description: When Star's biggest hero Mina Loveberry, a rogue magic-wielder from Mewni, loses her mojo for battle, Star attempts to help her get it back.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x10
episodes_data.description: King Butterfly pays a surprise visit to Star during the Diaz family camping trip and brings with him his own brand of camping.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x11
episodes_data.description: When Star and Marco are in charge of watching Buff Frog's tadpoles, the duo’s babysitting styles clash.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x12
episodes_data.description: While Star and Marco are babysitting his tadpoles, Buff Frog goes on a mission to steal Mewnian corn but keeps thinking about his tadpoles during the job.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x13
episodes_data.description: Star and her friends wait in the longest food truck line ever for the universe’s best hot dog, the Goblin Dog.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x14
episodes_data.description: After an argument with Star, Glossaryck goes into hiding in a donut box.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x15
episodes_data.description: Star competes in the Game of Flags at the Butterfly-Johansen family reunion against her mother’s orders.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x16
episodes_data.description: When Star is nominated as Mayor of Detention, she must help her constituents with their various problems.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x17
episodes_data.description: Marco sets out to impress Jackie at Star’s slumber party, but a magical truth-telling game threatens to reveal too much for Star.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x18
episodes_data.description: Marco must use a gift card before it expires with catastrophic results.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x19
episodes_data.description: When Tom vies for Marco's company instead of Star's, Marco becomes suspicious.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x20
episodes_data.description: Worried about his tadpoles' futures, Buff Frog investigates the hole in the Mewman force field.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x21
episodes_data.description: Star and Marco help Mr. Diaz create the scariest Haunted House on the block.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil 2x22
episodes_data.description: Star's most entertaining spell, Spider with a Top Hat, wants to become a fighting spell instead.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Star returns to her home dimension of Mewni where she discovers that magic is disappearing throughout the kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Star must dig deep and challenge archnemesis Ludo in an effort to save her family and kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Despite dire warnings, Ludo tries to write a new chapter in the Book of Spells.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: King River struggles to keep the kingdom running without Queen Moon's help.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Buffrog helps Star escape from Moon's ever-protective watch.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: With Ludo in control of the kingdom, Marco must decide his next move.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: King Ludo's reign reaches as a tipping point as Star returns to the castle. Star must summon her strength to save her family and the kingdom.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Star secretly keeps Marco's hoodie as a reminder of their friendship.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Star has recurring visions of Glossaryck and believes he's haunting her.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Tom snubs Star at the Silver Bell Ball.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Star meets the ancient Queen Eclipsa.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Star and Tom's relationship is put to the test when Tom decides to get rid of his demons.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Marco decides to put a full effort into living life in the present on Earth.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Knight of the wash, Sir Lavabo, gets a familiar squire.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Star prepares for the Midnight Warrior Blowout Sale at Quest Buy.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: A surprise visitor pressures Marco to reveal Turdina's true identity.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Star goes out into the field to understand why Mewmans treat Monsters unfairly.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Star discovers she travels through multiple dimensions in her dreams.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Kelly breaks up with her boyfriend and Marco questions his friendship with Star Butterfly.

episodes_data.title: Star vs. the Forces of Evil Season 3 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Star urges the royal youth of Mewni to sign a petition calling for the equal treatment of monsters.
